nodes.name: Lemma 9
Lemma 4
nodes.statement:
Let $f\colon \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ and
$
	\Gamma_t(n,f, Y_0) 
$
as above.
There exists a positive constant $K$ (depending on $\sigma_\pm$) such that
$|\Gamma_t(n,f,Y_0)| \leq K \|f\|_{1} {\sqrt{n t}}$
and if $\langle \lambda_\sigma , f \rangle=0$ then it holds that
$ |\Gamma_t(n,f,Y_0)| \leq K \left( \| f \|_{1,2} + \| f \|_{1,1} |Y_0| {\sqrt{n}}\right)$ 
and
$
|\Gamma_t(n,f.Y_0)| \leq K \| f \|_{1,1} (1+ \log(n t)).
$

nodes.name: th:j2:item1:2: Item
nodes.statement:
Let $(Y_t)_{t\in [0,1]}$ be the OBM with threshold $r=0$ strong solution to~(2.8) on a stochastic basis $(\Omega, \mathcal{F}, (\mathcal{F}_t)_{t\in [0,1]},\mathbb{P})$ (where the filtration is the natural one associated to $Y$), let $\gamma >3$, and let $h\in \mathcal{I}_{\gamma}$.
\\
Then constant $K_h^Y$ given by~(2.16) (with $f=h$, $X=Y$, $\mu_X=\lambda_\sigma$, $\beta=0$) is a non-negative finite constant, 
and there exist a sequence of stochastic processes 
$(\mathcal{V}^n_t)_{t\in [0,1]}$, $n\in \mathbb{N}$,
and a sequence $(\mathcal{M}^n_t)_{t\in [0,1]}$, $n\in \mathbb{N}$, of $(\mathcal{F}_{{\lfloor n t \rfloor}/{n}})_{t\in [0,1]}$-martingales
such that for all $t\in [0,1]$, $n\in \mathbb{N}$
\begin{equation} 
	n^{1/4}\left( \varepsilon_{n,t}^{(0,h,Y)} - \langle \lambda_\sigma , \mathbf{E}^Y_{h} \rangle L_t(Y)\right)
	=		 
	\mathcal{M}^n_t + n^{1/4} \mathcal{V}^n_t,
\end{equation}
$
	\sup_{s\in [0,1]} m^{1/4} |\mathcal{V}^m_s| \xrightarrow[m\to\infty]{\mathbb{P}} 0
$, 
and for all $t\in [0,1]$, $n\in \mathbb{N}$ it holds that
$
	\mathcal{M}^n_t =  \sum_{k=1}^{\lfloor n t \rfloor} \chi^n_k
$
where $(\chi^n_k)_{k\in \{1, \ldots, \lfloor n t \rfloor\}}$, $n\in \mathbb{N}$,
are random variables satisfying:
\begin{enumerate}[i)]
\item 
	for all $k\in \{1, \ldots, \lfloor n t \rfloor\}$
$\chi^n_k$ is square integrable $\mathcal{F}_{\frac{k}{n}}$-measurable
and
$
	\mathbb{E}\!\left[ \chi_k^n | \mathcal{F}_{(k-1)/n}\right] = 0$,
\item 
for all $t\in [0,1]$ it holds that
$
	\sum_{k=1}^{\lfloor n t \rfloor} \mathbb{E}\!\left[ (\chi_k^n)^2 | \mathcal{F}_{(k-1)/n}\right] \xrightarrow[n\to\infty]{\mathbb{P}} K_h^Y L_t(Y),
$

\item 
for all $t\in [0,1]$ it holds that
$
	\sum_{k=1}^{\lfloor n t \rfloor} \mathbb{E}\!\left[ \chi_k^n (Y_{k/n}-Y_{{(k-1)}/n})| \mathcal{F}_{(k-1)/n}\right] \xrightarrow[n\to\infty]{\mathbb{P}} 0
$,
\item 
for all $\varepsilon \in (0,\infty)$ it holds that
$
	 \sum_{k=1}^{n} \mathbb{E}\!\left[ |\chi_k^n|^2 \mathbf{1}_{\{|\chi_k^n|\geq  \varepsilon \}}| \mathcal{F}_{(k-1)/n}\right] \xrightarrow[n\to\infty]{\mathbb{P}} 0
$.
\end{enumerate}

nodes.name: Lemma 8
nodes.statement:
Let $g\colon \mathbb{R}^2 \to \mathbb{R}$ be the real function satisfying
$
	g(x,y)=|y|-|x|.
$
Then for all $t\in [0,\infty)$ it holds that $\langle \lambda_\sigma , \mathbf{E}^Y_{g} \rangle=1$,
\begin{equation}
	\varepsilon_{n,t}^{(0,\mathbf{E}^Y_{g},Y)} := \frac1{\sqrt{n}}\sum_{k=0}^{\lfloor n t \rfloor-1} \mathbf{E}^Y_{g} (\sqrt{n}Y_{k/n})
	=  \sum_{k=0}^{\lfloor n t \rfloor-1}  \mathbb{E}\!\left[  L_{(k+1)/n}(Y) - L_{k/n}(Y) | \mathcal{F}_{k/n} \right]
\end{equation}
and 
$
	\sup_{s\in [0,t]} \Big| 
\varepsilon_{n,s}^{(0,\mathbf{E}^Y_{g},Y)} 
- L_s(Y) \Big| \xrightarrow[n\to\infty]{\mathbb{P}} 0.
$

nodes.name: Proposition 7
Lemma 3
nodes.statement:
Let $f\in \mathcal{L}^{1}_{b}(\lambda^{(2)})$, and let us denote by $p(t,\cdot)$ is the density of a Gaussian random variable with variance $t$.
Then there exists a positive constant $K\in (0,\infty)$ such that for all $x,y\in \mathbb{R}$, $0 \leq s\leq t$ it holds that
\begin{enumerate}[i)]
	\item  
$
	|Q^\sigma_t f (x)| \leq \frac1{\min\{\sigma_-, \sigma_+\}} \left(1+\frac{|\sigma_- -\sigma_+|}{\sigma_-+\sigma_+}\right) \frac1{\sqrt{2 \pi}} \frac{\|f\|_{1}}{\sqrt t}, 
$
	\item 
$ 
	\left| Q^\sigma_t f (x)  - \frac{2 \sigma_-\sigma_+}{\sigma_-+\sigma_+} \langle \lambda_\sigma , f \rangle p(t,{x}/{\sigma(x)}) \right|\leq \frac{K}{\sqrt{t^3}} \left( \| f \|_{1,2} +\| f \|_{1,1} |x|\right),
$
	\item  for all $\zeta \geq 0 $ there exists a positive constant $K_\zeta$ such that\\
$ 
	\left| Q^\sigma_t f (x)  - \frac{2 \sigma_-\sigma_+}{\sigma_-+\sigma_+} \langle \lambda_\sigma , f \rangle p(t,{x}/{\sigma(x)}) \right|
\leq  

\frac{K_\zeta}{t} \left( \frac{\| f \|_{1,1}}{1+(|x|/(\sigma(x)\sqrt{t}))^\zeta} +\frac{\| f \|_{1,1+\zeta}}{1+(|x|/\sigma(x))^\zeta} \right),
$
	\item  
$ 
	\left| Q^\sigma_t f (x)  - Q^\sigma_t f (y) \right| 
\leq \frac1{\min\{\sigma_-, \sigma_+\}} \left(1+\frac{|\sigma_- -\sigma_+|}{\sigma_-+\sigma_+}\right) K \frac{|x-y|}{t} \|f\|_{1}
$, and
	\item  
$ 
	\left| Q^\sigma_t f (x)  - Q^\sigma_s f (x) \right| \leq  \frac1{\min\{\sigma_-, \sigma_+\}} \left(1+\frac{|\sigma_- -\sigma_+|}{\sigma_-+\sigma_+}\right) K \frac{t-s}{\sqrt{s^{3}}} \|f\|_{1}.
$
\end{enumerate}

nodes.name: Lemma 10
nodes.statement:
Let $\gamma\in [0,\infty)$, $h \colon \mathbb R^2 \to \mathbb R$ be a measurable function such that $\mathbf{E}^Y_{h}$ is well defined and $\mathbf{E}^Y_{h}\in \mathcal{L}^{1}_{b}(\lambda^{(\gamma)})$ (e.g.~$h\in \mathcal{I}_{\gamma}$ by Lemma~2), and let
$\mathbf{G}_{h}$ be the function defined in~(B.11).







Then $\langle \lambda_\sigma , \mathbf{G}_{h} \rangle=0$ and $\mathbf{G}_{h} \in \mathcal{L}^{1}_{b}(\lambda^{(\gamma)})$.

nodes.name: Lemma 6
Proposition 6
nodes.statement:
Let $g_n \colon \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$, $n\in \mathbb{N}$, be a sequence of functions satisfying
$\lim_{n\to\infty} \|g_n\|_{1} =0$ 
and for all $x\in \mathbb{R}$ it holds that
$\lim_{n\to\infty} \frac{1}{\sqrt{n}} g_n(\sqrt{n} x) =0$.
Then for all $t\in (0,1]$ it holds
\begin{equation}\lim_{n\to\infty} \mathbb{E}\Big[ \sup_{s\in [0,t]} \big|n^{-1/2}  \sum_{k=0}^{\lfloor n s \rfloor-1} g_n(\sqrt{n} Y_{\frac{k}n}) \big|\Big]=0.
\end{equation}
